description: Copy a published card into this server's rubrics (a new rubric id; the card is not changed) so `evaluate` can use it. The rubric's metadata records where it came from and its licence.

hub.description: Address of the hub to ask. Default: the hub this server was started with (VERDICT_HUB_URL).

name.description: name for the copy (default: the card's)

ref.description: `hub:owner/slug` for the newest version of a card, or `hub:owner/slug@rv_…` for one version, as `hub_search` returns it.

name: fork_rubric
title: Fork a hub card
